meta.promptText: Which brand's formal shirts should I buy for men in India?

response.text:
If you're buying men's formal shirts in India, I'd focus on **fit, fabric quality, comfort in Indian weather, and value for money** rather than just the brand name.

My recommendation is to start with these brands, depending on your budget and the kind of look you want.

## Best brands for men's formal shirts in India

![Buy White Shirts for Men by VAN HEUSEN Online | Ajio.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/FmJNqGwguBlKACLTc1sN_sAoiJhp3vQmhklf145y0naceRlhMqA9T7S-ByrjBGIg2V65f0Li_IGYo5YuTo0y8dYFGT_ZrXlNOh9hhuxxxSVeW4CP-pQxUNu_-qe_PH5o2sQgMF4M_hzBYGe9n45n4CpuFCMjAdvxPxZcnG8RnFNcKKsHs2PJReogulvb39a_?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Van Heusen — Best overall for office wear**

A strong starting point for a polished corporate look, with classic colours and contemporary fits.

Best for: Daily office wear, meetings and presentations.

---

![Buy Louis Philippe Men White Slim Solid Full Sleeves Formal Shirt Online](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/QOBLJgi1oberHkq3L7O9DC5ClJkfMCq21VtymPb8biSkY0R6jM2F_i-kjqcEeArl-1FKk2owe_NCcAYkkClYmJgvDQx2dqZVzyBzFR3AgiW9Hkx_o4F6qRGsOpQP58VXUlxrTlVV3fXQwKNiC4BddlZM7xoSSN-M-lbMId7QxrTehjHTyu9jdQwS0s3705s8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Louis Philippe — Best for a premium look**

Worth considering if you prefer elegant styling, refined details and a more executive appearance.

Best for: Senior professionals, client meetings and formal occasions.

---

![Buy Arrow Solid Manhattan Slim Fit Shirt - NNNOW.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nja7AAVHJZ2hTGzkRzD16z2qZOXf8wG6NZzq7aVU4orneBBm5pk9k7_ziYi96resXOZLxM_N3GXCNWdEUVS2Q0HVubwVlAS-TVJNP_iBqm-B9t7O9kS9dq8gB06aT6N7MNs74v2k-9HtScJU6j38_zxbQQa_obIdhLExvcIf0FDSLkK_mBPDIxsXwtjPRtA-?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Arrow — Best for classic business style**

A good option if you like traditional formal shirts that pair easily with trousers and blazers.

Best for: Corporate offices and conservative dress codes.

---

![Online Fashion & Lifestyle Shopping for Women, Men & Kids in India - Tata CLiQ](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/wvhyeyNRQm9GkVop36-5ApIKCy1rcMguwJ3VgI9UoACpHZcU-UYUabzMVpNgjxBVmKshUNreiIOG0GnSvoA3wwRFNXa-vmdAkkiEd7weu81aOTbGl-edIdhXFbPnC-ZZ5qzZu9FwMp7bs_wVn_I6kLmdHdeTHPJgcZnsGy2askr1dvvn4vrH6VRReTc-JkN8?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Peter England — Best for value**

A practical choice for building a work wardrobe without spending too much on each shirt.

Best for: Everyday office use and buying multiple shirts.

---

![INDIAN TERRAIN Men Solid Slim Fit Formal Shirt | White](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/k32CTLBtYTLyhGbZ9p7Hz2zmMfjnmeoa_rRkl89z5AbULebaH5engiHdlSE7THTz1Gu0SnfF0GcHcZErQrC29mraXKENKGe5uGcSO4W7vMIovpNBn66vPjjnQXQWkek3qKcRPdl27_AuP4rTemqWmfRBk1Qj2zBne6ZYe8kyy_LCFQhQq2wJXP0LmeCwe1Ik?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Indian Terrain — Best for smart everyday styling**

Consider it if you want a modern, understated look that can work for business-casual offices as well as regular formal wear.

Best for: Smart-casual workplaces and versatile wardrobes.

## Which one should you actually buy?

| Your priority | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Best all-round office shirt | **Van Heusen** |
| Premium, sophisticated appearance | **Louis Philippe** |
| Classic formal style | **Arrow** |
| Best value for money | **Peter England** |
| More premium fabric options | **Marks & Spencer** |


These picks align with recent Indian menswear comparisons, although actual quality varies by individual shirt and collection. ## What I would buy first

Start with a **white, a light blue and a pale pink or subtle striped shirt**\. Choose cotton or a breathable cotton blend, and make sure the shoulders, collar and sleeves fit properly. For Delhi summers, breathability matters; for long office days, easy-iron fabric can be useful.

You can browse current options from [Van Heusen](https://www.vanheusenindia.com/), [Louis Philippe](https://www.louisphilippe.in/), and [Arrow](https://arrow.nnnow.com/)\.

search_results.title: Slaying at work with Ikat & Ajrakh
search_results.description: Men’s corporate wear in India is undergoing a significant transformation, embracing vibrant colours, diverse prints, and traditional Indian textiles like Ikat and Ajrakh. This shift is driven by relaxed workplace dress codes and the rise of hybrid work environments, encouraging versatility in office attire. Professionals are moving beyond the classic navy, black, and white shirts to include micro-prints, botanical motifs, geometric and art-deco inspired designs. Fashion brands such as Nicobar, The F.A.R. Store, Rare Rabbit, and Thomas Scott are integrating Indian craft techniques like Batik and block printing into modern workwear. The definition of formal attire is becoming more relaxed, favouring breathable fabrics, relaxed fits, and comfortable styles that transition seamlessly from professional to personal settings. Retailers like Galeries Lafayette and Uniqlo are also promoting versatile shirts suitable across various occasions. This trend highlights a growing preference among men, especially in the 25-35 age group, for clothing that combines style, comfort, and cultural authenticity.
